caption: The drawing features a large, prominently colored brown bonnet centrally positioned on a beige background. The bonnet is depicted in a side view, showing detailed ridged and ruched fabric, with a ruffled edge along the inner face and a darker brown band along the lower edge. Two long beige ribbons extend from the bottom, curling toward the lower left corner of the image. Below and to the right of the main colored bonnet, two smaller line drawings of the same style of bonnet appear. One is a rear view, displaying circular stitched detailing and a ruffled edge at the bottom with ribbon ties, while the other is a three-quarter side view repeating the ruched, gathered body with long ribbons. Near the bottom right corner, the name "Roberta Spicer" is written in small script. The composition is simple, with the main colored illustration dominating the space and the smaller sketches providing additional views.
title: Calash
